result.topic_en: Riemann compares differentiation of the generalized Taylor-type expansion with respect to h and with respect to x to derive the recursion for the coefficients k_ν and the law that the n-th derivative of a fractional-order derivative raises its order by n, then plans to choose the free periodic function so that orders add under composition.
